the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, North slot 2, South slot 3, West slot 4
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: West moved 0.21 line heights, North moved 0.12 line heights, South moved 0.08 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one

digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$30K (donations)”
